children: Celldex reported positive Phase 3 EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 results for barzolvolimab that met primary and all key secondary endpoints.
Both EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 met the primary UAS7 change at Week 12 and all key secondary endpoints.
Barzolvolimab showed rapid, profound, sustained efficacy with improvements from Weeks 12 to 24 across doses.
High complete response rates (UAS7=0) at Weeks 12 and 24 vs placebo; strong effects in omalizumab-refractory patients.
Well tolerated with a favorable safety profile through the 24-week placebo-controlled period.
Treatment continues to 52 weeks and a BLA submission to the FDA is planned for 2027.
